LIBRARY.description: Absolute path to the wrapper shared library (e.g., /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libfakeroot.so.0)

DEFAULTS_TO_FAKED_BIN.description: Absolute path to the faked binary (e.g., /usr/bin/faked)

LOAD_FILE.description: Path to a file from which to load a previously saved fakeroot environment (via -i)

SAVE_FILE.description: Path to a file where fakeroot state will be saved on exit (via -s)

UNKNOWN_IS_REAL.description: If true, unknown files inherit real ownership instead of defaulting to root:root (via -u)

FD_BASE.description: Minimum file descriptor number to use for internal TCP connections (TCP mode only; via -b)
